_comment: Spec 179 §8: the committed known-development-example declarations for the news-risk shadow read. These companies were examined BEFORE spec 179 existed, so they may exercise the feature but can never serve as validation evidence: the read-only evaluator marks their rows KnownDevelopmentExample and excludes them from the clean prospective table. THIS FILE — not git history — is the declaration mechanism; the evaluator reads it directly, and a missing/unreadable file suppresses the clean table entirely (fail closed). Add a ticker BEFORE inspecting it through this feature, never after its outcome is known.
